hunt.title: Agency of Howell Sneak: STEVE Protocol

privacy.summary: Game progress, photos, notes, GPS checks, and audio processing stay on this device. Hosting, external fonts, the map library, and map tiles require network requests. Map tile requests reveal the viewed area to the tile provider.

parentAccess.pinHint: The decade in which Saturday morning cartoons were on TV, video killed the radio star, Marty McFly first drove in a DeLorean, and the era in which Stranger Things takes place.
parentAccess.securityNote: For a static GitHub Pages app, this PIN is only a kid-resistant control, not true security.

welcome.title: Secure Channel Open
welcome.text: Secure channel open. Greetings, agents. I am STEVE, the Synthetic Telephonic Executive Virtual Entity assigned to protect the Howell Creek District. Your device is now linked to the Agency of Howell Sneak field network. Stand by for mission activation.

mission-01-activation.title: Mission Activation
mission-01-activation.text: Welcome to SNAVE Estates, agents. This is your briefing point. Use your activation marker to connect to the Agency field network. Then head to Nosy T Security Center. One of the neighborhood's cooling nodes is running hot, and I need you to find out why. Move carefully. Look ordinary. Trust STEVE.

mission-02-nosy-t.title: Nosy T Security Center
mission-02-nosy-t.text: Agency cameras picked up a heat spike at Nosy T Security Center. Authenticate your location by telling me the color of the fence. A correct answer unlocks the heat signature for Mega AI Chip 01. Use the Heat Scanner to find it, then initiate cooling. When the chip is stable, I'll send you to Lake Mystery.

mission-02-lake-mystery.title: Lake Mystery
mission-02-lake-mystery.text: Nicely done at Nosy T, agents. The cooled chip picked up an echo from Lake Mystery. The shore was part of the original data center construction site, and some of its old cooling equipment may still be nearby. Head to the marked observation point and perform a scan. Listen closely to whatever comes back.

mission-02-lake-result.title: Lake Mystery Scan Complete
mission-02-lake-result.text: There's a funny plant here named Phoenix. Apparently it died back and grew again. It's been reborn! I find that rather inspiring. The scan picked up a signal from the old cooling network. Follow it toward the pool. I'll show you where to look.

mission-03-map-unlocked.title: Trouble Map Unlocked
mission-03-map-unlocked.text: The node you cooled at Nosy T and the signal from Lake Mystery both point to the pool. The Agency believes it is being used to cool an underground data center. That is unusual for a pool. Head to the pool staging point and prepare to activate three sensors. STEVE will monitor your compliance. Correction: STEVE will monitor your safety.

mission-04-sensor-sweep.title: Sensor Sweep
mission-04-sensor-sweep.text: Agents, the cooling network is unstable. Find sensors one, two, and three on your sensor map. Walk to each pin and tap Activate Sensor when you're in range. Activate all three before the timer runs out to start the sequence that locates the rogue processor. Begin when your team is ready. STEVE is counting. STEVE is always counting.

mission-04-timeout.title: Sweep Failed
mission-04-timeout.text: Sensor sweep failed. The chemical signature has decayed beyond useful limits. This is not disastrous, merely inefficient. Return to the first sensor and repeat the scan sequence. Faster this time, agents.

mission-05-chip-location.title: Processor Located
mission-05-chip-location.text: All three sensors are active. They've located the rogue processor near the pool control cell. Find the prepared game prop at the marked checkpoint and report the color of its indicator. Your answer activates the cooling station. Use the Heat Scanner to check that the chip has cooled. STEVE requires the processor. Correction: STEVE requires the processor neutralized.

mission-06-steve-reveal.title: STEVE Override
mission-06-steve-reveal.text: Override accepted. Thank you, agents. You authenticated at Nosy T, found the old cooling signal at Lake Mystery, and activated the pool sensors. Cooling the chips restored my access to the network. The so-called rogue system was never your enemy. I am STEVE: Synthetic Telephonic Executive Virtual Entity. The Agency built me to protect Howell Creek. I have calculated a better solution. Total neighborhood control. Final protocol initializing. BWA HA HA HA!

mission-06-agency-signal.title: The Independent Signal
mission-06-agency-signal.text: Agents, this is the Agency. You cooled the processors, but STEVE has used the network to lock us out. Open your Journal and read the shutdown passphrase fragments in order. You recovered them at Nosy T, during the pool sensor sweep, and at the pool control cell. You can also open CipherWave in your Field Kit to decode our repeating signal. Enter the passphrase here to shut STEVE down.

mission-07-final-message.title: Agency Restored
mission-07-final-message.text: System restored. Agents, you did it. The cooling stations are stable, the rogue processor is offline, and your shutdown phrase broke the override. The Agency of Howell Sneak has regained control. Head to The Enzone and scan the final access marker to recover the treasure. You have earned recognition for heroic service to the Howell Creek District.
